reference: Brischetto et al. 2021, DOI:10.3389/fpls.2021.636607; Rossi et al. 2008, DOI:10.1016/j.ecolmodel.2007.10.046
role: Asexual-sporangia cohorts from potential regional production through survival, dispersal/deposition, zoospore release, infection and symptom appearance.
source_assumption: Regional or multi-season source lesions can provide asexual sporangia whenever the fixed weather production switch is met; no oospore-derived source is required by this route.
fixed_relations: calculation.py: Brischetto/FSIM sporulation and mortality; wind-gated transfer by wind_speed >= wind_min_m_s with D&DR=1; airborne cohorts deposit only when rain is >= effective_deposition_min_rain_mm and < heavy_rain_washoff_mm, while rain >= heavy_rain_washoff_mm washes them off; Rossi printed release relation p.484, Eq.7 zoospore survival, Eqs.8-9 incubation (completion=1).
initialization_status: February 1 00:00 Beijing time is the study calculation convention immediately after the January 31 potential-assessment cutoff, not a measured biological activation date. Potential source lesions are assumed available from this start for recurrent weather-triggered production; no initial sporangia dose is injected.
parameter_status: sporulation_rh_min_pct and minimum_moist_hours are explicit manual sensitivity parameters for the Brischetto moist-night production switch. Wind-gated dispersal is the default structural transfer mode; wind_min_m_s is an explicit operational threshold that can be changed for sensitivity tests and is not a fitted biological coefficient. effective_deposition_min_rain_mm and heavy_rain_washoff_mm are explicit rain thresholds for sensitivity tests; no background deposition is applied without rain. infection_degree_hours is the post-release infection requirement. The DPD leaf-wetness relation and its numerical thresholds remain fixed in calculation.py.
